parent_objective: run no-training sequence-level command-response interventions over M1236 normal-surviving rows
blocked_by: M1236 single hidden-state swaps are history-insensitive
supersedes: continuing single hidden-swap tuning on M1236

public_gates: M1238 must preserve actor input contract
M1238 must not use private holdout
M1238 must report normal, cross-fault, temporal, reset/warm, zero-command, action-only, and normal-failed outcomes separately
M1238 must not claim self-identification without a separate audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden fault labels or hidden parameters to actor inputs
do not count temporal-only positives as cross-fault positives
do not count action-only rows as outcome evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs a bounded no-training sequence-level command-response intervention probe after normal-survival repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-training probe only; no promotion, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if no sequence signal appears and the branch needs synthesis
stop if positive rows are source-collapsed and require audit
fallback_plan: if normal-failed dominates, return to timing repair
if no signal appears, synthesize or redesign source construction
if temporal-only signal appears, audit before corpus export
if cross-fault signal appears, audit source diversity before objective work
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1237 admits the sequence intervention probe

admission_evidence: M1236 single hidden swaps are history-insensitive
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: positive or negative signal is routed to audit or synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1238 tests sequence history interventions but still requires audit before any stronger self-ID claim.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Sequence evidence is still public diagnostic evidence until source-diversity and outcome audits pass.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If sequence interventions are null or action-only, record the negative and do not train.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Sequence-level command-response interventions over M1236 normal-surviving rows will expose stronger temporal-history dependence than single hidden-state swaps.
failure_criteria: trace reconstruction fails for all rows
hidden fault/event labels enter actor observations
decision_rule: M1238 passes as a no-training probe if it produces sequence intervention artifacts and a classified result without actor mutation, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion. Any positive result still requires audit.
